scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:expected && npm run build:app
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release -p fb-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/fb_wasm.wasm
scripts.build:app: cargo build --release -p fb-server && npm --prefix ../../web ci && npm --prefix ../../web run wasm && npm --prefix ../../web run build
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:browsers
